messages:
ellie_csm: Quick sync: Sam from EdgeWave confirmed they'll join our private preview. They need SSO + audit logs and said predictable P95 latency is a deal driver. Need an onboarding plan and risk register.

sam_edgetech: Hi all, Sam (EdgeWave infra). We prefer VPC peering; expected peak QPS 10, baseline 2-3. NDA signed. I'll send SAML metadata and a small smoke dataset.

josh_se: I can run the tech enablement. Pre-kick runbook for EdgeWave: share SAML metadata, provide <=100-row test dataset, confirm peering vs allowlist, and give expected concurrency windows.

miguel_prod: Product asks: 3 representative prompt flows, top 5 failure modes, and we'll instrument latency histogram + token rejection metric. Recommend weekly 30m review + a one-page digest.

amanda_cs: I'll own feedback capture: short Typeform survey post-session + weekly NPS pulse for the first month. Will include emoji quick checks during sessions.

priya_ops: Tentative kickoff hold: Thu Apr 9 10:00 PT. I added pre-reads and Zoom link to the invite. Please review and update the shared drive doc.

finance-bot: Billing reminder: preview usage is billable unless finance approves a credit. Add estimated monthly token usage to the onboarding doc.

josh_se: Deploy team asked for a dry-run slot. Proposed: Apr 8 21:00 UTC. deploy-bot: queued.

miguel_prod: I'll add a regression triage template with severity tags (info/warn/blocker) and a 5-prompt human spot-check.

ellie_csm: Owners: Josh->tech enablement & validation, Amanda->feedback cadence, Miguel->eval template & digest, Priya->scheduling, Ellie->customer kickoff & risk escalation. Tag blockers in doc as "blocker:preview" for fast triage.

sam_edgetech: Sending SAML now and attaching smoke dataset. Thanks everyone.

ellie_csm: Great. I'll post a 24h pre-kickoff reminder in #customer-success and update the risk register entry for P95 SLA.

amanda_cs: First pulse ready; will share before the kickoff. :thumbsup:
